title: The Use of Butyrate Therapy in Pediatric Ulcerative Colitis
official: Butyrate Therapy in Hispanic Children With Ulcerative Colitis
summary: Butyrate is an important metabolite produced by the gut microbiome and has been shown as a helpful therapy in ulcerative colitis. This is a feasibility study to determine the efficacy of butryate enemas in pediatric ulcerative colitis.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 7-21 years, mild to moderate ulcerative colitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* UC therapy within 4 weeks of study medication initiation
* infectious colitis, -pregnancy
